<span id="toc8"></span>
<p id="_e17f00b2-1ef5-ff32-34a0-ba82758b6bed">This OGC Standard specifies a Web API that enables the execution of computing processes and the retrieval of metadata describing their purpose and functionality. Typically, these processes combine raster, vector, coverage and/or point cloud data with well-defined algorithms to produce new raster, vector, coverage and/or point cloud information.</p>
